column1: # How people actually type Malayalam in Latin letters, and what they mean by
# it. Two kinds of spelling are here, and neither is reachable from the
#  - Words the rules get wrong because Latin spelling does not carry the
#    difference: vowel length nobody marks ("pole" is പോലെ, "venam" വേണം),
#    ര against റ and ല against ള ("paranju" is പറഞ്ഞു, "vellam" വെള്ളം),
#    ട against റ്റ for "tt" ("patti" is പറ്റി), ന against ണ ("pani" പണി),
#    and the closing half-u ് against a full ു ("onnu" ഒന്ന്, "vannu" വന്നു).
#  - Chat shorthand that drops letters wholesale: "nthu" for എന്ത്, "evde"
#    for എവിടെ, "njn" for ഞാൻ, "enik" for എനിക്ക്.
# The phonetic rules already cover the regular patterns (ivide ഇവിടെ, ente
# എന്റെ, undu ഉണ്ട്, ningal നിങ്ങൾ, sukham സുഖം), so a word is listed only
# when they miss it. A hand-written draft of the commonest few hundred words
# that wants a Malayalam speaker's review.
# Format: spelling<TAB>malayalam   (one mapping per line; # starts a comment)
# A spelling may repeat to offer several forms, most-preferred first.
